notes: Encore is a clipboard history in the macOS menu bar. The demo opens its popover with demo.clickMenuBarItem() before demo.begin().
History starts empty on every recording. demo.copy("…") puts text on the app's private clipboard, and Encore records it within half a second, as the newest row.
A popover row is one accessibility element named by the clipping's title (its text, for a short clipping); its default action copies it. The chevron is a button named "Show Details".
The popover's search field is named "Search".
